description: Read-only. Check a filled ProjectKeeper table (like `pk check`): its shape against the schema, its ids and references, and every source against the project's files. Lists every problem, or says there are none. Needs no workbench.

project.description: The project folder. Default: the folder holding the table's projectkeeper/ folder.

sessions.description: The session-material.jsonl the table quotes the owner from (written by `pk sessions`).

table.description: The table file, e.g. projectkeeper/project.json. Relative paths start at the server's folder.

name: projectkeeper_check_table
